title: 7 Types of Washbasin Ideas to choose from for your perfect Bathroom
metaTitle: Types Of Washbasins: Uses, Types & Selection Tips | Prayag
description: Explore types of washbasins from Prayag for reliable quality and practical use. View key features, specifications and applications for homes and projects.
bodyHtml:
After a long day at work, bathrooms have a way of calming and rejuvenating us. We spend a standard of one hour and 42 minutes in our bathrooms per week, which is a huge amount of time. So why not add a touch of class to your bathroom by replacing your old wash basin with a new and stylish one from Prayag?

These distinct washbasin ideas go with a variety of bathroom types, from conventional to eclectic. You can pick washbasin that blend in with the rest of your bathroom décor or go with a bold design that stands out. Choose a washbasin that fits your personality and sense of style. We’ve different hand-picked types of washbasins designs below for you to choose from.

Wall-Mounted basin

Compared to the more common pedestal basin, wall-hung washbasins are good at revamping space while still looking great. Sometimes referred to as a cloakroom basin or small sink, this highly versatile washbasin design is ideal for small bathrooms, ensuites, and cloakrooms. One of the significant benefits of a wall-mounted basin is that it can be fixed at any height, which is very useful if you require to install a small basin in a child’s bathroom, for example. They are also much more accessible to clean without a pedestal and especially so if the plumbing is concealed.

Vanity Mounted basins

Top Vanity washbasins are in fashion right now and are also a popular choice for outdoor settings such as the garden or dining area. They are easy to install, requiring only a small space on top of a table or vanity. These counters can be made of glass, wood, marble, or metal. These kinds of washbasin designs add a luxurious and modern look that suits a large variety of bathroom styles.

Countertop Wash Basin

Countertop Washbasin is installed above the countertop, which is the most ancient traditional design technique. The countertop basin has a beautiful display. It comes in many shapes and colors round, square and other patterns, and has an excellent decorative effect. Easy to install and has a high face value.

Acrylic Basin

Acrylic sinks are made of heat-molded acrylic plastic backed with fiberglass and resin, making for a less-expensive alternative to enamel-on-steel sinks. Acrylic sinks come in dozens of compositions and colors. Acrylic does not splinter as easily as enamel, but hot pots can heat the material.

Stainless Steel Basin

Stainless Steel Basin is a perfect blend of style and performance. Made from heavy-gauge steel, these stainless steel washbasins, combining pedestal wash basin and stainless steel washbasin, without pedestal, are highly reliable and absolutely scratch proof. The beautiful curves, clean cuts, and satin finish of the basin make it an admirable addition for classic and contemporary kitchens.

Corner Wash Basin

One of the many types of bathroom sinks available today are corner basins. As you would imagine, they are basins placed in the corner of the bathroom between two walls. They are typically small and have small but usable mixer taps.

A corner basin will offer some very distinct benefits that will make them ideal for various homes and bathrooms.

Pedestal Wash Basin

A pedestal or shroud that is fixed to the floor of your bathroom supports pedestal basins. They’re a perfect option for an ensuite, powder room, or small bathroom because they maximize the amount of space available.

Vessel Sink Basin

As opposed to a conventional “drop-in” or under-mount sink, vessel sink is a basin that sits on top of a vanity countertop. The most popular materials used to make vessel sinks are glass and ceramic. Still, there are many other elegant finishes available, including stainless steel, natural stone, marble, copper and even wood.

We have all of the different styles and designs/models of washbasins available on the market. If you’re looking for a washbasin but can’t decide which one to get, leave a comment below with your specifications, and we’ll assist you in making a decision.
